text:
zoe: Quick flag  invoice preview diffs for a few tenants. Looks like late enrich commits landed after the preview snapshot.
matt: Are these significant amounts?
zoe: Mostly small, a spike for 2 enterprise tenants. I ran a query to list suspects.
raj: Can we avoid customer surprise by changing the UI? Maybe a tiny badge: 'preview may not include late events'.
ux: Agree - add preview timestamp + watermark age. Keep it subtle.
matt: Watermarks are ideal but we can't add latency. Alternative: surface a per-tenant late_event_rate and a risk dot.
raj: Risk dot sounds good; compute client-side from telemetry so no pipeline schema change.
ops-bot: Backfill requested: billing-backfill-1768123999 queued.
billing-bot: Alert created: preview delta > $3000 for 2 tenants (BILL-1204, BILL-1205).
zoe: For backfill, ensure idempotency. Last time we double-applied credits.
matt: Simple ledger check: if ledger.has_credit(event_hash) skip. Use run_id tag.
raj: Also add aggregator metric events_after_snapshot so we can alert before previews run.
ops-bot: Backfill complete: applied 212 credits, skipped 5 duplicates. Report: https://console.internal/billing/backfill/1768123999
ux: Follow-ups: (1) UI badge + watermark_age (2) risk-dot using late_event_rate (3) events_after_snapshot telemetry + alert rule (4) idempotent backfill pattern doc.
zoe: I'll own the UI PR. Matt/Raj pair on backfill and telemetry. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
